hypotheses.process_noise: Higher process noise reduces model-induced lag when fresh wheels agree, potentially at the cost of noise and fault acceptance.
hypotheses.adaptation: Adaptation time controls tracking of unmodelled acceleration versus contamination; test faster and slower alternatives.

plan.acceptance: At least 2% clean group-macro RMSE gain OR 5% fault-event group-macro RMSE gain. Neither aggregate may regress >1%. No bag/receiver clean RMSE regression >max(0.01m/s,10%). No coverage/sample count loss, false-stop increase, schedule changes, or causal violations. ROS CI required.
plan.data_policy: Existing validation is reused for selection; not independent test evidence. No final-test payload access or fitting on GNSS. All candidates and rejections retained.
